name: manual_005f2a
claim: No blanket 'always prefer ours' or 'always prefer theirs' rule is correct for a 3-way merge conflict — read and understand both sides' actual intent and judge case-by-case by which version is the strict quality/robustness superset of the other.

decisions.notes: In one blend pass, learn.py's conflict was resolved by keeping PT's 'ours' (fail-closed atomic-publish, a strict superset of upstream's simpler fail-open version) while recall.py's conflict in the same pass was resolved by keeping upstream's 'theirs' (a new shared superseded_by_map() helper superseding PT's own earlier local duplicate fix) -- opposite resolution direction, both correct.
